root@ec9d7e8ea249:/app# cat > fit.py << 'EOF'
> import numpy as np
> from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
> import json
>
> # Convert decimal commas -> dots so numpy can read it
> raw = open('graphene.dat').read().replace(',', '.')
> from io import StringIO
> data = np.loadtxt(StringIO(raw))
> x = data[:, 0]; y = data[:, 1]
> order = np.argsort(x)
> x = x[order]; y = y[order]
>
> def lorentzian(x, x0, gamma, amp, offset):
>     return offset + amp * gamma**2 / ((x - x0)**2 + gamma**2)
>
> def fit_peak(center, half, amp0, off0):
>     m = (x > center - half) & (x < center + half)
>     xf, yf = x[m], y[m]
>     p0 = [center, half * 0.1, amp0, off0]
>     popt, pcov = curve_fit(lorentzian, xf, yf, p0=p0, maxfev=200000)
>     return popt
>
> # G peak around x=19139
> mG = (x > 15000) & (x < 24000)
> g_off0 = np.median(y[mG][y[mG] < np.percentile(y[mG], 40)])
> g_amp0 = y[mG].max() - g_off0
> gp = fit_peak(19139, 5000, g_amp0, g_off0)
>
> # 2D peak around x=33244
> mD = (x > 28000) & (x < 40000)
> d_off0 = np.median(y[mD])
> d_amp0 = y[mD].max() - d_off0
> dp = fit_peak(33244, 6000, d_amp0, d_off0)
>
> result = {
>     "G":  {"x0": float(gp[0]), "gamma": float(abs(gp[1])), "amplitude": float(gp[2]), "offset": float(gp[3])},
>     "2D": {"x0": float(dp[0]), "gamma": float(abs(dp[1])), "amplitude": float(dp[2]), "offset": float(dp[3])},
> }
> with open('results.json', 'w') as f:
>     json.dump(result, f, indent=2)
> print('G  params:', gp)
> print('2D params:', dp)
> EOF

> def show(lo, hi, step=20):
>     print(f'--- region [{lo},{hi}] ---')
>     for i in range(len(x)):

root@ec9d7e8ea249:/app# cat > fit2.py << 'EOF'
> import numpy as np
> from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
> import json
>
> raw = open('graphene.dat').read().replace(',', '.')
> from io import StringIO
> data = np.loadtxt(StringIO(raw))
> x = data[:,0]; y = data[:,1]
> order = np.argsort(x); x=x[order]; y=y[order]
>
> def lorentzian(x, x0, gamma, amp, offset):
>     return offset + amp * gamma**2 / ((x - x0)**2 + gamma**2)
>
> def do_fit(lo, hi, p0):
>     m = (x>lo)&(x<hi)
>     xf, yf = x[m], y[m]
>     popt, pcov = curve_fit(lorentzian, xf, yf, p0=p0, maxfev=500000)
>     resid = yf - lorentzian(xf, *popt)
>     ss_res = np.sum(resid**2); ss_tot = np.sum((yf-yf.mean())**2)
>     r2 = 1 - ss_res/ss_tot
>     return popt, r2
>
> # G peak
> gp, gr2 = do_fit(18000, 20500, [19139, 400, 65000, 14000])
> # 2D peak
> dp, dr2 = do_fit(31000, 35500, [33245, 800, 2250, 19000])
>
> result = {
>   "G":  {"x0": float(gp[0]), "gamma": float(abs(gp[1])), "amplitude": float(gp[2]), "offset": float(gp[3])},
>   "2D": {"x0": float(dp[0]), "gamma": float(abs(dp[1])), "amplitude": float(dp[2]), "offset": float(dp[3])},
> }
> with open('results.json','w') as f:
>     json.dump(result, f, indent=2)
> print('G :', gp, 'R2=%.5f'%gr2)
> print('2D:', dp, 'R2=%.5f'%dr2)
> EOF

root@ec9d7e8ea249:/app# cat > fit_final.py << 'EOF'
> import numpy as np
> from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
> import json
>
> raw = open('graphene.dat').read().replace(',', '.')
> from io import StringIO
> data = np.loadtxt(StringIO(raw))
> order = np.argsort(data[:,0])
> x = data[order,0]; y = data[order,1]
>
> def lor(x, x0, gamma, amp, offset):
>     return offset + amp*gamma**2/((x-x0)**2+gamma**2)
>
> def fit_peak(p0, bounds, lo, hi):
>     m = (x>lo)&(x<hi)
>     xf, yf = x[m], y[m]
>     popt, _ = curve_fit(lor, xf, yf, p0=p0, bounds=bounds, maxfev=500000)
>     pred = lor(xf, *popt)
>     r2 = 1 - np.sum((yf-pred)**2)/np.sum((yf-yf.mean())**2)
>     return popt, r2
>
> gp, gr2 = fit_peak([19200,450,60000,15000],
>                    ([18000,50,1000,0],[20000,2000,100000,40000]),
>                    18500,19900)
> dp, dr2 = fit_peak([33245,950,2750,18500],
>                    ([32000,100,100,15000],[34500,3000,10000,21000]),
>                    31500,35500)
>
> result = {
>   "G":  {"x0":float(gp[0]),"gamma":float(abs(gp[1])),"amplitude":float(gp[2]),"offset":float(gp[3])},
>   "2D": {"x0":float(dp[0]),"gamma":float(abs(dp[1])),"amplitude":float(dp[2]),"offset":float(dp[3])},
> }
> json.dump(result, open('results.json','w'), indent=2)
> print('G :', gp, 'R2=%.5f'%gr2)
> print('2D:', dp, 'R2=%.5f'%dr2)
> EOF
